splash.tagline: Your personal course and study platform

vault.title: Select or Create a Study Vault
vault.subtitle: Your vault stores course organization, study progress, and metadata portably.
vault.noRecent: No recent vaults found. Create or open one to get started.
vault.deleteSubtitle: Choose whether to only unlink or permanently delete files.
vault.deleteFilesCheckbox: Permanently delete all files from disk
vault.deleteFilesWarning: Warning: All videos, materials, and folders within this directory will be permanently deleted!
vault.unlinkExpl: When unchecked, the vault is only removed from Orbia. Your original files on disk remain 100% safe and intact.

home.emptySubtitle: Import your first course folder or drop courses into your Vault's Inbox to start learning.

course.deleteConfirmDesc: This will remove the course and its progress from Orbia. Your original files on disk will not be deleted.

player.linkHint: This lesson is a web link. Open it in your default browser.
player.documentHint: This file can be opened with your default system application.
player.documentLoadError: Could not load this file. Open it externally instead.
player.noNotes: No notes yet for this lesson
player.noNotesSubtitle: Take timestamped notes while watching to retain your learning.
player.errorDesc: Unable to decode this video file or the file contains corrupt packets.
player.noResources: No materials are attached to this lesson.

merge.title: Review Course Organization
merge.subtitle: Detect and review separate course parts before any future organization.
merge.previewSubtitle: Review a read-only organization proposal. Nothing changes in your library.
merge.noSuggestedGroupsDescription: You can still select courses to review a safe organization preview.
merge.reviewSelectionDescription: Choose at least two courses to calculate a read-only proposal.
merge.previewError: Could not calculate the organization preview.
merge.mergeError: Could not merge the selected courses.
merge.applyFutureDescription: Applying this proposal is unavailable until a reversible operation plan is ready.
merge.previewSafetyNotice: This proposal preserves every module, lesson, and candidate for your review.
merge.noModuleChanges: No secondary modules require a change in this proposal.
merge.duplicateCandidatesNotice: These are review candidates only. No lesson or material is removed automatically.
merge.autoOrganizeDesc: Detects mistakenly merged courses (separating them), unifies modules with identical names, and merges parts of the same course without manual selection.
merge.libraryOrganized: All courses and modules are naturally ordered and organized.
merge.advancedManualMergeDesc: Select manually only if you want to force-merge specific course parts.
merge.cleanDesc: No duplicate course parts were detected at this time.
merge.infoNotice: Clicking 'Merge and Organize' will combine all modules and lessons from the parts above into the primary course and automatically deduplicate identical lessons.
merge.manualDesc: Select 2 or more courses to join them into one. All modules and lessons are preserved, nothing is deleted.

documents.title: Document Viewer
documents.nonPdfHint: This document format can be viewed by opening it in your default external application.

notes.title: Lesson Notes
notes.emptyNotes: No notes yet for this lesson. Click above to add your first note!

import.title: Import Course
import.selectFolderSubtitle: Choose a course folder or .zip archive containing videos, modules, and study materials.
import.dropZone: Drag & drop a folder or .zip archive here
import.previewSubtitle: Review and customize the detected modules and lessons before adding to your library.
import.duplicatesExcluded: Potential duplicates are preserved for your review. No file is removed automatically.
import.deleteZipAfterImport: Always delete the .zip file after importing (save space)
import.zipTransferNotice: The original .zip remains in place until a successful approved import. Its saved deletion preference is applied only afterward.
import.multiSourceDescription: Choose several sources at once. Each stays untouched until you approve its import.
import.noCoursesFoundInRoot: No courses found in subfolders of this root directory.
import.processingDescription: Validating files and detecting modules before preview.
import.validationDescription: This source was not added to the preview. Discard its temporary preparation or choose a replacement source.
import.validationNoDetails: The source did not pass validation.
import.sourcePathUnavailable: Could not resolve the selected file: {{name}}
import.noValidSources: No valid course sources could be prepared.
import.prepareFailed: Could not prepare this course for preview.
import.selectAtLeastOne: Select at least one course to import.
import.pathsStayPrivate: Source locations stay private and unchanged until approval.
import.zipManagedOnly: ZIP imports are stored in the Vault
import.zipManagedOnlyDescription: A ZIP cannot be linked externally. The original is kept unless its saved preference is applied after a successful import.
import.referenceExternalDescription: Keep the original folder in place and link it to Orbia.
import.saveToVaultDescription: Move the approved course into Vault/Courses.
import.noLessonsDetected: No playable lessons detected in this module.

history.title: History
history.empty: No history yet. Start watching lessons to track your study sessions.
history.noImportsDesc: When you import .zip files or course folders, the sending and extraction history will appear here.

settings.autoPlayNextDesc: Countdown 5 seconds then load next lesson

settings.studyGoalsDesc: Customize your daily study time targets and weekly completion goals

settings.weeklyLessonsGoalDesc: Target number of completed lessons per week to track in the dashboard
settings.offlineFirst: 100% Offline-First • Zero Mandatory Cloud • Complete User Privacy
